findings.claim: The new `runs` destination navigates to `/admin/runs`, but nothing in the packet evidences that this route exists — the Flat 2.0 allowlist enumerates the admin pages (agents, auth, compiler, cost-dashboard, credentials, knowledge, memory, models, providers, runtime-console, settings, skills, tools) with no runs page — so the rail link, palette command, and breadcrumb may point at an unhandled route.
findings.evidence: nav-destinations.ts adds `{ id: "runs", path: "/admin/runs", ... }` with no matchPaths fallback; scripts/frontend-flat2-style-allowlist.txt lists frontend/src/admin/pages/*.tsx and contains no runs page, only runtime-console-page.tsx. Spec requirement 'Compact navigation retains complete route access' and the proposal's 'current /threads, /admin/*, and /about routes remain valid' assume the target is real.
findings.suggested_fix: Confirm `/admin/runs` is registered in App.tsx routes; if the runs surface is actually the runtime console, point the destination at that path (or add matchPaths) before shipping.

findings.claim: The brand contract test asserts exact equality between `frontend/public/brand/` and `docs/ui/logo/`, but the diff does not add any `docs/ui/logo/` assets and the file tree shows only the unexpanded `./docs/ui` directory — if the delivered source assets are not committed, `readdirSync` throws and the test fails in CI; it also makes frontend unit tests depend on files outside the frontend workspace root.
findings.evidence: uar-logo.test.ts: `filesBelow(resolve(projectRoot, "../docs/ui/logo"))` with `expect(publicAssets).toEqual(delivered)`; the diff's new files cover only `frontend/public/brand/*` and `openspec/*`, never `docs/ui/logo/*`; the file_tree lists `./docs/ui` with no visible `logo` children.
findings.suggested_fix: Either commit `docs/ui/logo/` as part of this change (and list it in files.txt), or replace the directory-equality assertion with an explicit expected asset list rooted inside frontend/.

findings.claim: This change introduces a 391-entry ESLint baseline that suppresses the Flat 2.0 style gate for pre-existing violations — including files this diff itself touches (admin-shell.tsx border-b/backdrop-blur entries, ThemeToggle.tsx filename-case) — so acceptance criterion 5.2's 'Pass … Flat 2.0' is achieved by masking the gate rather than by the touched code complying, and any reviewer can no longer distinguish 'gate passes' from 'gate suppressed'.
findings.evidence: New file scripts/frontend-flat2-style-allowlist.txt header: 'Generated baseline for C-03 flat2-style-gate… Entries are exact ESLint findings'; it contains entries for frontend/src/admin/admin-shell.tsx (4 no-restricted-syntax findings) and frontend/src/components/ThemeToggle.tsx, both modified in this diff; tasks.md criterion 5.2 claims the Flat 2.0 check passes.
findings.suggested_fix: Verify the allowlist was generated from the base commit (not from this branch's working tree), and confirm the new shell files (app/shell/*, shared/ui/*) produce zero gated findings without allowlist coverage; state that explicitly in the change's verification evidence.

findings.claim: The global Ctrl/Cmd+K handler does not guard against `event.repeat`, so holding the keys down auto-repeat-toggles the palette open and closed.
findings.evidence: app-shell.tsx `openCommandPalette` toggles `commandPaletteOpen` on every keydown with no `event.repeat` check.
findings.suggested_fix: Add `if (event.repeat) return;` before the toggle branch.

findings.claim: All favicon links are SVG-only; browsers without SVG favicon support get no icon even though the diff ships raster 16/32px PNGs under /brand/png/.
findings.evidence: index.html replaces `/favicon.svg` with three `/brand/uar-favicon-*.svg` links; frontend/public/brand/png/uar-appicon-dark-16.png and -32.png are added but never referenced in the head.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a raster fallback such as `<link rel="alternate icon" type="image/png" sizes="32x32" href="/brand/png/uar-appicon-dark-32.png" />`.
